items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I never got paid for that Gary McFarland date.

ctx.x: Um-hmm. Yeah, because we were out looking for that. I said, I got to hear that one. Then Gary McFarland, and then Luis Gasca.
Yeah, I never got paid for that Gary McFarland date. But guess who did?
